text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Up next, we have the latest news from
the
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
First up is Mejiro Dober, a promising
rookie from
the Mejiro family, who
showed up strong in last
year's Hanshin
J.F.!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Her fans have high expectations for her
in the
Tiara tour...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since the start of the year, Mejiro Dober
has
been drawing far more enthusiastic
attention from
the public than I had
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I worry whether this attention will be a
good or
bad thing, as I head to the
academy to talk with
her about the
coming year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the training course, I see Mejiro
Dober and
Mejiro Bright warming up
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober's trainer! Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober's trainer! Happy New Year!
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Here's to another year together.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'm looking forward to working
with you
again this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's all make this year a wonderful one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's all make this year a wonderful one!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, it's Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
And she's with Mejiro Bright! How lucky
are we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know what's happening, a
large group
of reporters starts rushing
toward us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh goodness. Are you here for an
interview?
There sure are a lot of you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Mejiro Dober! Could you tell
us about
your plans for your classic
year?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Since you ran in the Hanshin J.F., does
that mean
you'll be aiming for the Tiara
tour? It's become a
hot topic among
your fans!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Is it true that you and Mejiro Bright are
secretly
training together for your classic
year?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Please give us all the details!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
We'd prefer to hear from Mejiro Dober
herself!
choice_data_list: I'll take any questions for now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Please, Miss Dober! Your fans would
love to hear
what you have to—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: That includes thisâplease make sure you always run things through me!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
But the world is longing to hear from her
directly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear! My goodness, I seem to have
forgotten
something of mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Come with me, Dober! Keep me
company while I
go fetch it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait! Please come back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid I must take her with me. I'm so

airheaded that I'll likely forget more of
my things
without Dober to accompany
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh... Uh, y-yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Thanks for that, Bright. And, uh... you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Thanks for that, Bright. And thank you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whatever do you mean? I only asked
you to come
with me to retrieve a
forgotten item.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whatever do you mean? I only asked
you to come
with me to retrieve a
forgotten item.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You don't have to play dumb. If you
actually
forgot something, how come
you're
empty-handed?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, actually, I seem to have forgotten
what it
was I had forgotten! ♪ What an
airhead I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If you say so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, why were there so many reporters
around?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nothing like that has ever happened
before...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...On me?
choice_data_list: That just shows how much attention you're getting.
That just shows how much attention you're getting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural after your performance
in the
Hanshin J.F.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: With how exceptionally well you've been doing, it'd be difficult not to attract attention.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about that, but... are things
going to
be like this forever?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, who can say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure your trainer will make it
abundantly
clear that unauthorized
interviews are not
welcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: R-right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems a bit
discombobulated after
all that. Maybe
she could do with a good change
of
pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since it's New Year's, I suggest a

holiday-appropriate activity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?! Where'd that come from?
choice_data_list: Let's do some New Year's calligraphy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's gotten into you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Karuta? That sounds lovely! The
perfect
New Year's activity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Karuta? That sounds lovely! The
perfect
New Year's activity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not you too, Bright! We still have to
train!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How nostalgic! We used to play karuta
all
together as a family, and Dober
would cry
because she couldn't get any
cards.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! That was back when I was
practically a
baby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Last year, I did way better than you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, did you? Last year was so long
ago. I
hardly remember how things went.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Grr... You're the one who brought up
ancient
history!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I suppose we'll just have to decide who's
better
with a rematch, then. Let's get
started, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, fine... I'll play if you want to that
badly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Okay, let's have your trainer read
the
poems for us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day, Mejiro Dober
ends up in a
much better mood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Talk about sudden...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Mochi soup! What a wonderful
suggestion,
and a timely one too! I was
just starting to feel
peckish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Time to eat some stretchy, stretchy
mochi! Hehe!
What a happy thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I thought we were going to train, thou—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We should hurry and buy the
ingredients. Let's
see, for traditional
mochi soup, we'll need...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What kind of vegetables are in it again?
Celery?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Stop it right there, Bright! I'll help
make it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And you! Don't just stand there. This was
your
idea, so make yourself useful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too confident in my cooking
skills,
though, so can you help us too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I help the two of them make Mejiro-style
mochi
soup, and we all eat it together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I help the two of them make Mejiro-style
mochi
soup, and we all eat it together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only does Mejiro Dober's mood
improve, I
also get to learn about
Mejiro-style cooking, so
it's a good start
to the new year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-New Year's calligraphy? What a
random
suggestion...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-New Year's calligraphy? We weren't
even
talking about that, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a marvelous idea! I haven't
done mine
yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a marvelous idea! I haven't
done mine
yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we take this opportunity to
write our
resolutions for the year,
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure putting them on paper will
motivate us
even more in training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I guess we can do that... It'll be
embarrassing to
write them together,
though. My calligraphy's not
so great...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What's important is the feeling behind
your
words, not the neatness. Just pour
your heart into
the brush strokes, and all
will be fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's get started right away! Your trainer
should
join us too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of us write our goals for the
classic year
and show them to each
other!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems focused, and I sense

ambition in the letters she pens: "Triple
Tiara."
